arc_age: Observed accepted membership in current supplied arc prefix, exactly as retained V2; not ordinal subtraction. Partial replay cannot recover unrecorded earlier membership.
availability: Missing text yields unavailable signatures; empty present text yields empty sets and zero counts, with undefined ratios null. Incomplete windows reported with count/complete flag. GLiNER coverage affects only retained V2 readings.
content: Unique non-stopword non-numeric tokens, no stemming or semantic equivalence.
coupling: For each family, fraction of new environment signatures exactly present in same-turn Gemma; lag1 current Gemma against previous-turn newly introduced environment signatures. Denominator/matched signatures retained; zero denominator null. Echo is not understanding.
limitations: Units are literal; no conversion or spelled-number handling.
Quantity occurrences can be plans, headings, identifiers, times, or wrong references.
Unrecognized-unit numeric values remain bare numbers.
State windows react to paraphrase/padding and do not resolve negation scope.
Content novelty/trigram recurrence cannot establish conceptual movement.
Exact quantity echoes can invert meaning while scoring full echo.
No direct exploration opportunity or understanding measurement is available.
measurement_input: Only INPUT_KEYS from preserved V2; movement reads exact current participant/Gemma text and accepted identity/arc ordering. No labels, extractor requirements or runtime hooks.
new_count: |current signatures minus union of previous up-to-W same-arc turns|, unavailable on opening/missing history.
paired_coordinates: environment quantity new fraction and model phrase recurrence reported separately; no scalar, classification, threshold, maturity multiplier or policy hook.
per_100_words: 100*new_count/tokenizer word count; null for zero denominator.
phrases: Unique contiguous original-token trigrams, including stop words and negation.
quantities: Unique Decimal-normalized numeric strings with literal optional unit (casefold/whitespace normalized), excluding numeric ordered-list prefixes. No unit conversion, reference assignment or fact/plan distinction.
recurrence: maximum Jaccard(current set, each prior turn set) over W prior turns; unavailable for missing text or any empty union.
retained_v2: Separate unchanged measure_pressure_records call over identical safe records. Historical/state diagnostics not redefined.
states: Each fixed marker plus up to two adjacent original tokens on either side; exact lexical signatures, not propositions. Span quotes retained.
summary_correlations: Unfitted Pearson r within trajectory/window, >=3 available pairs and both nonconstant. Same-turn env quantity/content novelty versus model content novelty; uncapped model word count versus model novelty/phrase recurrence/echo. Tiny autocorrelated descriptive series only.
